findings.confidence: observed static logic; no runtime/server response observed

findings.claim: StreakData records length, startTimestamp, updatedTimestamp, updatedTimeZone and nullable xpGoal, deriving a ZonedDateTime from Instant and ZoneId.
findings.confidence: observed static model; one JADX enum error, these shown methods retained

findings.claim: LifetimeStreak has achieveDate, endDate, length and startDate.
FreezesToUse splits gift/society/standard freeze counts and sums them; exact award/consumption policy not established.
XpSummary records gainedXp, timestamp, frozen, repaired, streakExtended, numSessions and totalSessionTime; continuity flag is frozen OR repaired OR streakExtended.
findings.confidence: observed static model and boolean logic

findings.claim: Selectable streak goal constants expose 7, 14, 30 and 50 days.
findings.confidence: observed static constants; JADX enum reconstruction warning retained

findings.claim: Global XP-to-level curve, universal daily cap, effective server league cohort policy, remote experiments and full streak-credit algorithm are not established by this bounded eight-class pass.
findings.confidence: unknown; must remain own SuperHealth design rather than claimed Duolingo algorithm

integrationSuggestions: Show one compact progress bar (total XP to next level) separately from weekly comparable scores.
Keep history of personal records, current streak and personal best as distinct facts.
Use explicit local calendar/day boundaries, a completed-day calendar and optional per-tracker cadence.
Treat rest days and missing data according to the selected tracker cadence rather than requiring daily strength training.
Use SuperHealth-specific bounded XP rules and disclose that thresholds are its own design.
